### Summary of Findings & Verdict

* **Verdict:** **VIABLE** (`0` blocking critical issues; `4` non-blocking methodological/documentation improvements `O1`–`O4`).
* **Disposition of Prior Critical Issues (`C1`–`C5` from [h2_review1/review.txt](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/h2_review1/review.txt)):**
  1. **`C1` (Resolved):** [02_extract_neighbourhoods.py](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v3/scripts/02_extract_neighbourhoods.py#L644-L825) and [03_analyse_conservation.py](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v3/scripts/03_analyse_conservation.py#L139-L205) enforce locus-level eligibility (`eligible_locus_primary == 1`, requiring all 4 flanks in `{"mapped_KO", "mapped_noKO"}`) prior to KO aggregation across identical eligible species sets (`0.0 <= R_fam <= 1.0` across all 300 families; ineligible families coded `-1`), isolate unique same-strand/frame/overlap 3'-stop matches into Tier 2 (`133` evaluable families), and report join metrics separately for primary (`900` rows) vs. non-primary (`618` rows) loci in [pilot_join_metrics.json](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v3/results/pilot_join_metrics.json#L45-L108).
  2. **`C2` (Resolved):** [01_select_cohort.py](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v3/scripts/01_select_cohort.py#L105-L150) resolves 100% (`5,438 / 5,438`) of dRep 95% ANI species clusters to GTDB-Tk R232 taxonomy via `Cdb.csv -> Wdb.csv` (`0` unassigned phyla across all `1,461` Gate 3 and `300` pilot families). True nucleotide `contig_len_bp > 0` (`996 / 996` binned rows) and window completeness govern outcome-independent primary-locus selection ([02_extract_neighbourhoods.py](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v3/scripts/02_extract_neighbourhoods.py#L827-L852)), and all four multivariable OLS/HC3 and MLE/L2-penalized logistic regressions converge (`rank = 9 / 9`, `max SE = 3.0922`).
  3. **`C3` (Resolved):** [03_analyse_conservation.py](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v3/scripts/03_analyse_conservation.py#L313-L650) restricts Part (a) positional-null draws ($B = 5{,}000$) to same-contig indices satisfying the identical 4-flank mapping gate and `max_sp >= 2` recurrence rule (fixing the `max_sp == 1` discrepancy in earlier run `53710523`), demonstrating within-arm enrichment in both $K$ ($+35.97$ pp, $p = 0.0002$) and $Q \setminus K$ ($+26.08$ pp, $p = 0.0002$), while Part (b) tests the between-arm contrast on background-adjusted excess $E_{\text{fam}}$ via common-support stratified permutation (Tier 1 $\Delta_{\text{MH}} = -0.0648, p = 0.4907$; Tier 2 $\Delta_{\text{MH}} = +0.0119, p = 0.8678$), caliper matching with explicit residual-imbalance diagnostics (`25` soft pairs and `9` strict exact-phylum pairs), and converged regressions.
  4. **`C4` (Resolved):** `685 / 685` available bins pass exact forward-strand nucleotide SHA-256 and Bakta `.log` `orig-id` verification ([bin_contig_verification.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v3/results/bin_contig_verification.tsv)), `24` missing-annotation bins are explicitly recorded, and all `3,800` input files are SHA-256-pinned in [INPUTS.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v3/INPUTS.tsv).
  5. **`C5` (Resolved):** [DESIGN.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v3/DESIGN.md#L26-L40) and [DOSSIER.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v3/DOSSIER.md#L28-L53) explicitly bound the target population to the 12,556 90%-cluster representatives in `04_cluster/clusters.tsv` across the 4-stage attrition funnel and remove all novel-fold and operon claims.
* **Non-Blocking Methodological & Documentation Caveats (`O1`–`O4`):**
  * **`O1`:** The species-block bootstrap ([03_analyse_conservation.py](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v3/scripts/03_analyse_conservation.py#L859-L883)) reweights fixed pre-computed family outcomes and computes the unstratified difference (`+0.0989` baseline) rather than recomputing multi-species KO recurrence or $\Delta_{\text{MH}}(E_{\text{fam}})$; conditional exchangeability and cross-family independence should be stated as identifying assumptions/sensitivities rather than "verified" properties ([DOSSIER.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v3/DOSSIER.md#L152-L154)), and 4-bin phylum grouping is coarse taxonomic conditioning rather than full phylogenetic control.
  * **`O2`:** The full-cohort power claim ($\geq 80\%$ power for $|\Delta_{\text{MH}}(E_{\text{fam}})| \geq 0.12\text{--}0.15$ in [DOSSIER.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v3/DOSSIER.md#L225)) should either include its explicit variance-scaling derivation ($\text{MDE}_{80\%} \approx 0.119\text{--}0.138$ under infinite-population normal scaling) with a finite-catalogue caveat or be omitted.
  * **`O3`:** `best_ko_mobilome_flag` (`0 / 30`) checks 11 keywords only on flanks carrying `best_recurrent_ko` (where 8/30 top KOs have Bakta product `"hypothetical protein"`, 6 have COG category `S`, `K00590` is a `DNA methylase`, and `47.6%` of all Tier 1 flanks in those 30 families lack a KO); it should be described strictly as absence of phage/transposase keywords on top recurrent KOs rather than proof that mobile elements are absent or that all 30 contexts are core housekeeping/metabolic genes ([DOSSIER.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v3/DOSSIER.md#L166-L226)).
  * **`O4`:** Align the abbreviated primary-locus tie-breaker tuple in [DESIGN.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v3/DESIGN.md#L75) and [DOSSIER.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v3/DOSSIER.md#L56) with the exact 8-element outcome-independent sort key in [02_extract_neighbourhoods.py](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h2_v3/scripts/02_extract_neighbourhoods.py#L838-L847).
